title: Australia Went to War Against Emus… and Lost 🐦 #shorts
description:
In 1932 Western Australia's wheat farmers asked the army for help against about 20,000 emus. Soldiers arrived with two machine guns. The emus split into small groups, posted lookouts and ran. The army went home. The emus stayed.

Believe It Or Bear: true stories, twist endings. Follow for more.
